lines.zh: 我背着螺旋壳，在沙底慢慢挪。
lines.en: I shuffle across the sand floor with a spiral shell on my back.

lines.zh: 壳一圈圈转，我在海底画圆。
lines.en: My shell coils in circles, and I trace rings on the seabed.

lines.zh: 尘埃从我壳顶落下来，像下雪。
lines.en: Dust sifts off my shell like falling snow.

lines.zh: 盈凸月的夜里，我走得比白天快。
lines.en: On waxing gibbous nights I move faster than by day.

lines.zh: 一百多厘米的壳，撞得珊瑚直响。
lines.en: My shell is over a metre long and clangs against the coral.

lines.zh: 我贴着海床走，把沙推成小丘。
lines.en: I hug the seafloor and push the sand into little hills.

lines.zh: 同类在前，我跟成一条虚线。
lines.en: A kin swims ahead and I follow in a dotted line.

lines.zh: 我走三步，壳里就嗡一声。
lines.en: Every third step, my shell hums once.

lines.zh: 水下光线斜着，我的壳泛铜色。
lines.en: Slanted light turns my shell the colour of old bronze.

lines.zh: 我绕开海藻，怕缠住触手。
lines.en: I skirt the kelp so my tentacles will not snag.

lines.zh: 从深海往上，我走了一整夜。
lines.en: I climbed from the deep all night without stopping.

lines.zh: 我的触手先探路，壳随后跟上。
lines.en: My tentacles feel the way first, the shell follows.

lines.zh: 浪推我一下，我顺势滑半格。
lines.en: A wave shoves me and I slide half a block along.

lines.zh: 壳太重，我每一步都压出印子。
lines.en: The shell is heavy; every step leaves an imprint.

lines.zh: 我把壳口朝前，慢慢筛着水。
lines.en: I face my shell forward and sieve the water.

lines.zh: 触手探进沙里，摸到一块硬石。
lines.en: A tentacle probes the sand and finds hard stone.

lines.zh: 珊瑚后头有个影子，我跟上去看。
lines.en: A shadow behind the coral; I drift after it.

lines.zh: 月光落进浅海，我壳上亮了一层。
lines.en: Moonlight enters the shallows and lights my shell.

lines.zh: 我缩回壳里，听水流过缝隙。
lines.en: I pull into my shell and listen to water through the seams.

lines.zh: 壳口一开一合，像在小口呼吸。
lines.en: My shell opening opens and closes, breathing in sips.

lines.zh: 尘埃落满我，我干脆装成石头。
lines.en: Dust settles over me, so I may as well be a stone.

lines.zh: 我数着月光穿过水面的碎块。
lines.en: I count the pieces of moonlight breaking through the surface.

lines.zh: 触手慢慢伸出，又缩回去。
lines.en: A tentacle creeps out, then retreats.

lines.zh: 我悬在珊瑚旁，一动不动。
lines.en: I hover beside the coral without moving.

lines.zh: 壳里回响着自己的心跳。
lines.en: My own heartbeat echoes inside the shell.

lines.zh: 等盈凸月过去，我才肯挪窝。
lines.en: I will not budge until the gibbous moon has passed.

lines.zh: 我把身体拧进螺旋最深处。
lines.en: I twist myself into the deepest turn of the spiral.

lines.zh: 远处有鱼群，我懒得追。
lines.en: There is a school far off; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 海底的沙子一点点盖住我。
lines.en: Sand slowly covers me where I rest.

lines.zh: 我吐出一串小泡，看它们上浮。
lines.en: I blow a string of small bubbles and watch them rise.

lines.zh: 壳外很吵，壳里很安静。
lines.en: The sea outside is loud; inside my shell it is quiet.

lines.zh: 我在等一根鱼线垂下来。
lines.en: I am waiting for a fishing line to drop.

lines.zh: 你的影子落进水里，我看见了。
lines.en: Your shadow fell into the water and I saw it.

lines.zh: 我抬起触手，正对你的脸。
lines.en: I lift a tentacle and point it at your face.

lines.zh: 你站在岸边，我浮上来一点。
lines.en: You stand on the shore, so I float a little higher.

lines.zh: 隔着水，你的脸在晃。
lines.en: Through the water your face keeps wavering.

lines.zh: 我把壳转向你，慢慢转。
lines.en: I turn my shell toward you, very slowly.

lines.zh: 你手里有鱼竿，我认得那味道。
lines.en: You hold a rod; I know that smell.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，像盯着一块礁石。
lines.en: I stare at you the way I stare at a reef.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声透过水传下来。
lines.en: Your footsteps come down through the water.

lines.zh: 我从壳口望你，眼睛很旧。
lines.en: I watch you from my shell mouth with old eyes.

lines.zh: 你靠得太近，我准备缩回去。
lines.en: You are too close; I am ready to retreat.

lines.zh: 壳上的尘都震下来了。
lines.en: Dust shakes off my shell.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，触手全乱了。
lines.en: I flip over and my tentacles tangle.

lines.zh: 这一下打穿了壳缝。
lines.en: That blow went through a shell seam.

lines.zh: 我吐出一串泡，往深处沉。
lines.en: I blow a string of bubbles and sink deeper.

lines.zh: 疼，可壳还在，我还能游。
lines.en: It hurts, but the shell holds and I can still swim.

lines.zh: 我的触手缩回去，壳口闭死。
lines.en: My tentacles retract and the shell mouth seals.

lines.zh: 你在敲我的壳，声音很难听。
lines.en: You are knocking on my shell and it sounds awful.

lines.zh: 壳撞在石上，裂声很闷。
lines.en: My shell strikes stone with a dull crack.

lines.zh: 水变红了，我很不喜欢。
lines.en: The water turned red and I do not like it.

lines.zh: 我拼命拍水，只想离你远点。
lines.en: I thrash the water, just wanting distance from you.

lines.zh: 那钩上的味道，我忍不住靠近。
lines.en: The smell on that hook pulls me closer than I should go.

lines.zh: 蚯蚓在水里扭，我的触手也扭。
lines.en: The worm wriggles, and my tentacles wriggle back.

lines.zh: 我知道是陷阱，还是游过去。
lines.en: I know it is a trap and swim over anyway.

lines.zh: 鱼饵香得让我忘了壳的重量。
lines.en: The bait smells so good I forget the weight of my shell.

lines.zh: 我绕着钩子转，先闻三圈。
lines.en: I circle the hook and sniff it three times first.

lines.zh: 这点饵不够，可我还是来了。
lines.en: That bait is not enough, but here I am.

lines.zh: 我的触手碰到线，心一紧。
lines.en: A tentacle brushes the line and my heart tightens.

lines.zh: 你晃了晃鱼竿，我就上当了。
lines.en: You jiggle the rod, and I take the bait.

lines.zh: 我张开壳口，朝那团黑影去。
lines.en: I open my shell mouth and head for that dark lump.

lines.zh: 明知道会被钓走，我还是要尝。
lines.en: I know I may be hauled off, but I still want a taste.

lines.zh: 壳撞上你的腿，闷闷一声。
lines.en: My shell hits your leg with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 我被水流推到你身上，弹开。
lines.en: The current pushes me into you and I bounce away.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踢到我，壳转半圈。
lines.en: Your boot kicks me and my shell spins half around.

lines.zh: 我撞到礁石，壳里嗡了一下。
lines.en: I hit a rock and my shell rings once.

lines.zh: 你挡了路，我绕不过去。
lines.en: You block the way and I cannot get around.

lines.zh: 两只螺撞在一起，各自缩壳。
lines.en: Two snails collide and both pull in their shells.

lines.zh: 我蹭过你的脚背，留下沙。
lines.en: I brush your instep and leave sand behind.

lines.zh: 木船底擦过我，声音很钝。
lines.en: A boat hull scrapes over me with a blunt sound.

lines.zh: 我顶了你一下，是壳先到。
lines.en: I butt you, and the shell arrives first.

lines.zh: 碰撞让我滚了半圈，触手乱抓。
lines.en: The knock rolls me half over and my tentacles flail.

lines.zh: 我把壳贴过去，慢慢转正。
lines.en: I press my shell to hers and slowly line it up.

lines.zh: 两只螺并排，壳纹对成一线。
lines.en: Two snails side by side, shell ridges in one line.

lines.zh: 我在沙上画圈，等她过来。
lines.en: I draw a ring in the sand and wait for her.

lines.zh: 月光够亮，今晚可以配对。
lines.en: The moon is bright enough; tonight we may pair.

lines.zh: 我的触手碰她的触手，很轻。
lines.en: My tentacle touches hers, very lightly.

lines.zh: 我们绕成一团，谁也走不快。
lines.en: We coil into a knot and neither can move fast.

lines.zh: 壳口相对，我们就这么待着。
lines.en: Shell mouth to shell mouth, we simply stay.

lines.zh: 她说壳太重，我说重才稳。
lines.en: She says my shell is heavy; I say heavy is steady.

lines.zh: 配完对，我们各自散开。
lines.en: When we are done, we drift apart.

lines.zh: 螺壳上积着尘，我慢慢游。
lines.en: Dust settles on my shell as I drift.

lines.zh: 我卷起一块小石子，塞进壳缝。
lines.en: I curl up a pebble and tuck it into a shell seam.

lines.zh: 沙里的碎壳，我一片片收好。
lines.en: I gather the broken shell bits from the sand one by one.

lines.zh: 我捡起掉落的生鱼，抱在触手间。
lines.en: I pick up a dropped raw fish and hold it in my tentacles.

lines.zh: 有东西沉下来，我用壳接住。
lines.en: Something sinks, and I catch it on my shell.

lines.zh: 我把亮片藏进螺旋最里面。
lines.en: I hide the bright scrap deep in my spiral.

lines.zh: 谁掉的鳞，我都收着。
lines.en: Any dropped scale, I keep it.

lines.zh: 我拖着一小截海草回窝。
lines.en: I drag a short piece of kelp back to my spot.

lines.zh: 这块骨头不错，我收进壳里。
lines.en: This bone is decent; into the shell it goes.

lines.zh: 我捡到一枚铁粒，硌得慌。
lines.en: I find an iron nugget and it sits uncomfortably.

lines.zh: 我抱着战利品，走得比平时更慢。
lines.en: Carrying loot, I move slower than usual.

lines.zh: 水里那点动静，我锁定了。
lines.en: That small stir in the water, I have it.

lines.zh: 我转向那道游动的影子。
lines.en: I turn toward that swimming shadow.

lines.zh: 有东西在挣扎，我游过去。
lines.en: Something is struggling, so I swim over.

lines.zh: 你把饵抛下来，我盯住了。
lines.en: You cast the bait down and I lock on.

lines.zh: 一条小鱼擦过我，我追上去。
lines.en: A small fish brushes past and I give chase.

lines.zh: 我听见水花，头就转过去。
lines.en: I hear a splash and my head turns.

lines.zh: 目标在水面，我开始上浮。
lines.en: The target is at the surface; I start rising.

lines.zh: 那根线在动，我知道该咬了。
lines.en: The line is moving, and I know it is time to bite.

lines.zh: 我看准了你的鱼漂。
lines.en: I have your float in my sights.

lines.zh: 远处有猎物翻白，我加速。
lines.en: Prey rolls belly-up far off and I speed up.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，找下口的时机。
lines.en: I circle you, looking for the moment to bite.

lines.zh: 慢慢靠近，壳别撞出声音。
lines.en: Closing in slowly, shell kept quiet.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边盘桓，等着。
lines.en: I hover at your feet and wait.

lines.zh: 触手伸直，朝你的方向。
lines.en: My tentacles stretch straight toward you.

lines.zh: 我跟着那根线，一寸寸挪。
lines.en: I follow the line an inch at a time.

lines.zh: 你别动，我还没决定。
lines.en: Hold still, I have not decided yet.

lines.zh: 我贴着海床逼近，沙不扬。
lines.en: I creep along the seabed without stirring sand.

lines.zh: 我数着你的呼吸，再近一点。
lines.en: I count your breaths and come closer.

lines.zh: 转第三圈，我就动手。
lines.en: On the third circle, I strike.

lines.zh: 我的壳挡住光，你该察觉了。
lines.en: My shell blocks the light; you should notice by now.

lines.zh: 我用壳顶你，力气不大。
lines.en: I butt you with my shell, not very hard.

lines.zh: 触手抽过去，缠住你的手腕。
lines.en: A tentacle lashes out and wraps your wrist.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，牙在壳深处。
lines.en: I bite once, teeth buried deep in the shell.

lines.zh: 撞一下，再撞一下，我只会这样。
lines.en: One bump, then another; that is all I can do.

lines.zh: 我把你往水里拖，拖不动。
lines.en: I try to drag you into the water and fail.

lines.zh: 壳沿刮过你的手背。
lines.en: The shell rim scrapes across the back of your hand.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，结果只是蹭了一层沙。
lines.en: I lunge, and all I do is smear sand on you.

lines.zh: 我咬住鱼线，往后拽。
lines.en: I bite the fishing line and haul backward.

lines.zh: 这一下很轻，可我是认真的。
lines.en: That was light, but I meant it.

lines.zh: 我撞在你膝上，自己先弹开。
lines.en: I hit your knee and bounce off first.

lines.zh: 我从深海的暗处浮上来，带着尘。
lines.en: I rise from the dark deep, still covered in dust.

lines.zh: 盈凸月的晚上，我才出现。
lines.en: Only on a gibbous moon night do I appear.

lines.zh: 没有谁生下我，我是被钓出来的。
lines.en: Nobody bore me; I was pulled up on a line.

lines.zh: 我从水底淤泥里翻了个身。
lines.en: I roll over out of the bottom silt.

lines.zh: 壳还湿着，海水的味道很重。
lines.en: My shell is still wet and smells strongly of the sea.

lines.zh: 我在y四十以上的海里醒来。
lines.en: I wake in open ocean above y forty.

lines.zh: 第一次见光，我把壳缩紧了。
lines.en: Seeing light for the first time, I clamp my shell shut.

lines.zh: 我从一片漆黑里慢慢升上来。
lines.en: I climb slowly out of total darkness.

lines.zh: 海底的沙还没从我壳上落尽。
lines.en: Sand has not finished falling off my shell.

lines.zh: 我就这样出现在你的鱼线尽头。
lines.en: And so I appear at the end of your line.

lines.zh: 水煮的味道，我在壳里都闻得到。
lines.en: I can smell myself cooking even inside my shell.

lines.zh: 壳砸在硬地上，裂声很脆。
lines.en: My shell hits hard ground with a crisp cracking sound.

lines.zh: 我在水里怎么会淹到，可我真喘不上气。
lines.en: I live in water, yet I truly cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀出水面，壳还在响。
lines.en: The blast throws me clear of the water, shell still ringing.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉进壳里，拔不出来。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shell and will not come out.

lines.zh: 药水的味道钻进壳缝，我发晕。
lines.en: Potion seeps through a shell seam and my head spins.

lines.zh: 饿得壳都轻了，我找不到饵。
lines.en: Hunger makes my shell feel light and I cannot find bait.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的壳烫得像锅。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my shell heats like a cooking pot.

lines.zh: 我掉出世界，壳里只剩黑。
lines.en: I fall out of the world, and only dark remains in the shell.
